rows.note: Use 網頁 specifically for an internet page rather than a physical page.

example.english: This web page has all the registration information.
example.traditional: 呢個網頁有齊報名資料。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 mong5 jip6 jau5 cai4 bou3 meng2 zi1 liu6

rows.note: Use 頁 for a physical page or one side of a leaf in a book or document.

example.jyutping: cing2 nei5 tai2 dai6 sap6 jip6
